how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-sort:warlock-04.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7629:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E1⟧ to the alchemy lab in the ⟦E2⟧. After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:7629:details:0: There is one more process required for Mor'zul's parchment; I need paper infused with Xorothian stardust. And... I'm afraid I can't do that here. I don't have the equipment!
rows.quest:7629:details:1: There is an alchemy lab, however, with everything needed. It's in the ⟦E2⟧, on the isle of ⟦E4⟧ in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:7629:details:2: I can't make the trip, but here - take this jar. There's an imp inside who is quite clever. Let him out at the alchemy lab and he'll infuse the parchment.
rows.quest:7629:progress:0: Have you been to the ⟦E2⟧, ⟦1⟧? Has the imp yet infused the parchment with the stardust?
rows.quest:7629:completion:0: Ah, good. J'eevee created the parchment. How was the ⟦E2⟧? Charming, don't you think? And the bugs there... I hear they're delicious!
rows.quest:7629:completion:1: Well done, ⟦2⟧, and thank you for returning my jar. I've had it for a long time... and it's not for sale!
rows.quest:7630:details:0: Now that the Bell, Wheel and Candle are made, I should make a black lodestone. During your ritual, you'll need that lodestone to maintain the other ritual objects if they should fail.
rows.quest:7630:details:1: To make the lodestone, I require arcanite. Do you have any? If not, then... you'll have to get the arcanite from an alchemist.
rows.quest:7630:details:2: Return to me when you have the arcanite, and then I'll make the black lodestone.
rows.quest:7630:progress:0: Do you have the arcanite, ⟦3⟧? Once I have it I can make you the black lodestone.
rows.quest:7630:completion:0: You got it! Nicely done! Now I can create the lodestone. When you're finally ready for your ritual to create the Circle of Greater Summoning, you'll want a lodestone to make sure the ritual doesn't fizzle out!
rows.quest:7631:obj:0: Read ⟦E8⟧. Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.
rows.quest:7631:details:0: All the preparations are made. Now, you must perform the ritual to create a Circle of Greater Summoning, then use the parchment infused with Xorothian stardust... to open a portal to Xoroth.
rows.quest:7631:details:1: I have written the instructions for the ritual onto a scroll. Study it closely, for you must perform each step exactly if you wish to succeed.
rows.quest:7631:details:2: Fortune to you, ⟦4⟧. And may the souls of your ⟦E9⟧ swiftly find their way into your shard pouch.
rows.quest:7631:completion:0: The Xorothian Dreadsteed's spirit is beaten. Although rage pulses through its ghostly flanks, you know that the beast's soul is yours...
rows.quest:7631:completion:1: It whispers dark magic into your mind and instills within you the knowledge to summon a dreadsteed.
